_comment: Copy the 'dolibarr' entry into any MCP client's server map. Use an ABSOLUTE path to server.mjs — MCP clients (OMP included) do not reliably expand ${HOME} in args. Adjust the home dir per machine (here /home/arthur). command 'node' (Node >= 20); 'bun' also works. The server loads its own secret from ~/.secrets/dolibarr.env — no token in this file.
